GET /api/research-os/route returns the flags and writes them to a new graph.edge_flags table for a signed-in learner, best-effort. scripts/research-os/ingest/infer-edges.ts (no model, no --apply mode) scans the 517-node combined seed/Academy/canon graph and proposes 36 prerequisite edges from lexical overlap and tier ordering, confidence 0.3 to 0.65, all landing on the review list, none applied. scripts/research-os/ingest/canon-atom-map.json gained three explicit mappings resolving bell-theorem, quantum-field-theory, and quantum-mechanics from the prior four unmatched_derives_from entries; gauge-principle stays unmatched, no Academy atom covers gauge invariance or Yang-Mills theory. learning/research-os/ROUTING.md documents the routing rule, confidence sources, threshold, and teacher-flag resolution path. Skipped: the workspace chain badge (src/app/research-os/workspace/page.tsx was touched 22 minutes before this pass started, inside the 2-hour concurrent-edit window; deferred with a TODO), and LLM-assisted edge inference (the harder no-lexical-signal case, tracked in ros-13). 23 new unit tests, 117/117 passing across the full test:research-os suite. title: ros-08: preregistration draft, transfer task bank, instruments, IRB outline shipped
description: Branch docs/ros-08-preregistration ships four files under a new learning/research-os/study/ directory. PREREGISTRATION-DRAFT.md: an OSF-standard-template preregistration (Study Information, Design Plan, Sampling Plan, Variables, Analysis Plan, Other, plus a data availability statement) registering six directional primary hypotheses (H1 through H6) drawn from six of OVERLAP-RESEARCH-OS-AND-AI-FOR-RESEARCH.md's twelve questions, each sourced to a named RCT or meta-analysis (Bastani et al. 2025, Kosmyna et al. 2025, Kestin et al. 2025, Doshi and Hauser 2024, Deci Koestner Ryan 1999, Gneezy and Rustichini 2000, Roediger and Karpicke 2006, Barnett and Ceci 2002); the six left-out questions are named with reasons against PLAN-REVISION-1.md section 4's own Phase-1-versus-district-scale table. A power analysis computes naive and cluster-corrected per-arm n at three assumed effect sizes (d = 0.3/0.4/0.5, sourced to RESEARCH-OS-K12-SYSTEM-REVIEW.md section 9 and 04-compliance-distribution.md section 10) and three illustrative ICC values, finding Phase 1 underpowered for a confirmatory H1 test and registering it as a feasibility and effect-size-estimation pilot, with the fully powered target held for a Phase 2 extension of this same registration. The OSF template section order is sourced to van 't Veer and Giner-Sorolla (2016) after nine WebFetch attempts against osf.io returned no scrapeable template text (client-rendered SPA, 404s, a paywalled publisher redirect); the draft states this gap and instructs a live-form cross-check before any real submission. TRANSFER-TASK-BANK.md: forty-four sealed-pool transfer items, two per node, for all 22 nodes of the sky-blue seed path (supabase/seed/research-os-sky-blue.json, read in full), built by a stated eight-step construction rule (multi-hop requirement, Barnett-and-Ceci transfer-distance tagging, a documented per-node misconception as the distractor source, Bloom-revised process tagging, exposure-control item ids) that scales to any future corpus; the three canon-bridge nodes' items are grounded in learning/app/corpus/02-physics.json's own waves/em-waves/wave-optics atom lesson text. INSTRUMENTS.md: a retention probe schedule (immediate, 1 week, 8 weeks) reusing probe.ts's due-ness and grading pattern against the transfer task bank's sealed pool rather than repurposing the cold-start-only probeDue trigger; a metacognitive confidence item after every Check result plus an unrelated-topic confidence probe adapting Fisher, Goddu, and Keil (2015); a teacher time-on-review log operationalizing 04-compliance-distribution.md section 11's net-save-time adoption bar as a measured outcome. IRB-PACKET-OUTLINE.md: submission sections, consent and assent drafts for parents, under-13 students, 13-to-17 students, and teachers, a minimal-risk justification, a data-governance split between the operational FERPA school-official basis and the research consent track, and a founder-as-researcher conflict disclosure built on PLAN-REVISION-1.md section 5's two-PI pairing; states plainly that no IRB approval, partner PI, or partner school exists yet. RESEARCH-QUESTIONS.md gained eleven 'Pre-registered as of 2026-09-10' pointer lines under existing questions (Q2, Q5, Q8, Q11, Q13, Q19, Q22, Q24, Q29, Q30, Q33), no existing line rewritten. agf-lint-voice check clean (0 violations) on all five touched files; roughly forty antithesis-pattern sentences rewritten by hand, since that category is never auto-fixed. Docs only, no code or migration changed. PR opened against main, merge pending.

title: cognitive forcing on Check, calibration record, arm switch shipped
description: PR #63 (feat/ros-cognitive-forcing) against main, not yet merged. PLAN-REVISION-2.md section 2a's design response to Bucinca, Malaya and Gajos (2021), Bansal et al. (2021), and Vaccaro, Almaatouq and Malone (2024): before the tutor's grounded feedback is shown on the Check tool, the learner now writes an explanation, rates their confidence on forcing.ts's 4-point LearnerConfidence scale, and predicts which of their own quoted sources their explanation rests on; the verdict holds server-side (forcing.ts's in-memory held-attempt store, ATTEMPT_TTL_MS 30 minutes, matching rate-limit.ts's best-effort posture) until both arrive on the same attemptId. workspace/route.ts's check action becomes two-phase (no attemptId submits and grades, holding the verdict; attemptId present calls revealPendingAttempt, the single gate that returns ok:false with no grade field until both a valid learnerConfidence and a non-empty sourcePrediction are present in the same request); consumePendingAttempt makes reveal single-use. computePredictionCorrect checks a source prediction against the node's own citation label in code, never asking the model. Calibration record: learnerConfidence, sourcePrediction, predictionCorrect land in the evidence jsonb per an updated EVIDENCE-SCHEMA.md; calibration.ts's computeCalibrationSummary (mean confidence against mean source-prediction correctness, forcing-gated check events only) is wired into GET /api/research-os/class and rendered on /research-os/class, confirmed untouched by other in-flight work via git log -3 --since='2 hours ago' -- src/app/research-os/class before adding it directly rather than leaving it as an unexposed server function. Workspace page (page.tsx) Check card gains a third render phase: two grade-4-reading-level questions as native fieldset/legend/labeled radio-input groups (same accessible pattern /research-os/profile already uses), sourced from the learner's own "sources I have quoted" list; the reveal shows the learner's prediction beside the tutor's real citation and whether it matched. learning/research-os/study/INSTRUMENTS.md section 2 (the metacognitive confidence item) rewritten from its original after-the-verdict design to the shipped before-the-verdict placement; original text preserved verbatim in _intake/research-os-k12/DELETIONS.md. 28 new tests across scripts/test-research-os-forcing.ts (19, including the headline "feedback cannot be fetched early" case run directly against revealPendingAttempt, the production function the route calls) and scripts/test-research-os-calibration.ts (9), plus new onCheckResult/onProbeCheckResult coverage in scripts/test-research-os-evidence.ts; wired into npm run test:research-os. description: Review of PR #63 (feat/ros-cognitive-forcing) found the two-phase Check reveal's held verdict lived in an in-memory Map inside workspace/route.ts's module scope; on Vercel a phase-1 Check and its phase-2 reveal can land on two different route instances, silently losing the held verdict. title: ros-14: faded guidance for low-prior-knowledge learners, worked examples, guidance switch shipped
description: feat/ros-faded-guidance against main, not yet merged.
